import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G), G['Test input'][5])

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find small ring shape (non-bg, non-3 colored pixels)
    ring=None
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] not in (bg,3): ring=g[r][c]
    fill=ring-4  # ring 6 -> 2
    # find 3-rectangle: bounding box of 3s
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==3]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(r0+1,r1):
        for c in range(c0+1,c1):
            out[r][c]=fill
    return out

print(transform(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
out=transform(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)

import json,os
os.makedirs('programs',exist_ok=True)
prog='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg or seen[r][c]: continue
            col=g[r][c]; q=deque([(r,c)]); seen[r][c]=True; pts=set()
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); pts.add((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and not seen[na][nb] and g[na][nb]==col:
                        seen[na][nb]=True; q.append((na,nb))
            rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            border={(a,b) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if a in(r0,r1) or b in(c0,c1)}
            if pts!=border: continue
            area=(r1-r0-1)*(c1-c0-1)
            if area<=0: continue
            fill=7 if area%2==1 else 2
            for a in range(r0+1,r1):
                for b in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[a][b]=fill
    return out
'''
open('programs/task-531796a0.py','w').write(prog)
